name: Critical Security Service Start Type Modified
description: Detects modification of the 'Start' value for a critical security service (e.g., Defender, Firewall). This is a common defense evasion technique used by malware before execution.

action.description: The start type for a critical security service was modified, indicating a likely attempt to disable it.

operational_usage: A critical defense evasion indicator. SIEM should alert immediately. The 'Start' value is often changed to '4' (Disabled). Investigate the process that made the change.
false_positive: Very rare. Only enterprise management tools or administrators should perform this action. Any other source is highly suspect.
